task.title: Harness drain: gate 'fully drained' marker behind one-shot flag
task.description: After task 1053 added a synchronous emission of `'Harness fully drained — safe to restart'` from `Harness.drain()`, the main reconciliation loop continues to emit the same marker on every iteration while `_draining=True` and there are no active project loops, producing per-iteration log spam (~once every 5s).
task.details:
**Observed:** Reviewer suggestion on task 1053 merge. After drain() short-circuits and logs the marker synchronously (`fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/harness.py:228-229`), the main loop at `harness.py:599-608` will also emit the same marker on its next iteration (since `_draining=True` and tasks are empty), and continues emitting on every subsequent iteration.

**Fix (cheapest):** Add a one-shot bool `self._drain_complete_logged = False` initialized in `__init__`. Set it to True after either site emits the marker; gate both emissions on `not self._drain_complete_logged`.

**Files:**
- `fused-memory/src/fused_memory/reconciliation/harness.py` — drain() ~line 228, main loop ~line 599-601, __init__ to add flag
- `fused-memory/tests/test_harness.py` — add tests:
  1. Calling drain() twice on idle harness emits exactly one 'Harness fully drained' record (second call should only log 'Harness already draining').
  2. After drain() emits the marker synchronously, the main reconciliation loop does not re-emit it on subsequent iterations.

**Verification:**
- Existing test suite continues to pass.
- New tests assert exactly one marker emission across drain() + N main-loop iterations.
- Manual: `time scripts/restart-fused-memory.sh --drain` on an idle harness still completes in <30s with a single 'Harness fully drained' line in the journal.

**Origin:** Reviewer suggestions on task 1053 (esc-1053-180) — both the robustness suggestion (suppress duplicate marker emissions) and the test_coverage suggestion (assert drain()-twice contract) are addressed by this task.
